title: Migrate bc2adls from PTE to appsource extension
summary: The bc2adls extension for exporting Business Central data to Azure Data Lake Storage is now available on AppSource. Users with the existing PTE extension can migrate to the AppSource version using a migration app while preserving their exported data and configuration.
key_points: bc2adls moved from PTE to AppSource in 2026, providing easier updates and maintenance
A dedicated migration app copies data from PTE tables to AppSource tables automatically
Manual reconfiguration of Azure credentials (Tenant ID, Client ID, Client Secret) is required after migration
Users should verify migration success and test exports before uninstalling the old PTE extension
features: data export to azure data lake

quotes.text: bc2adls is available on appsource: Microsoft Marketplace
quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the official release of the extension on AppSource, enabling easy discovery and management

quotes.text: This migration app will automatically copy all the data from the PTE tables to the appsource tables.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key benefit: data preservation during the migration process without manual intervention
